an9.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme,
an9.11:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.11:1.6: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an9.11:1.7: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu acirapakkante āyasmante sāriputte bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.11:1.8: “āyasmā maṃ bhante, sāriputto āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkanto” ti.
an9.11:1.9: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
an9.11:1.10: “ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
an9.11:1.12: “evaṃ bhante” ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
an9.11:1.14: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā sāriputto tassa bhikkhuno paccassosi.
an9.11:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca ānando avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ anvāhiṇḍanti
an9.11:2.3: idānāyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sīhanādaṃ nadissatīti.
an9.11:2.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an9.11:2.5: idha te sāriputta, aññataro sabrahmacārī khīyanadhammaṃ āpanno.
an9.11:2.6: “āyasmā maṃ bhante, sāriputto āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkanto” ti.
an9.11:3.1: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:4.1: seyyathāpi bhante, paṭhaviyaṃ sucimpi nikkhipanti, asucimpi nikkhipanti, gūthagatampi nikkhipanti, muttagatampi nikkhipanti, khelagatampi nikkhipanti, pubbagatampi nikkhipanti, lohitagatampi nikkhipanti, na ca tena paṭhavī aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:4.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante paṭhavisamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an9.11:4.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya,
an9.11:5.1: seyyathāpi bhante, āpasmiṃ sucimpi dhovanti, asucimpi dhovanti, gūthagatampi dhovanti, muttagatampi dhovanti, khelagatampi dhovanti, pubbagatampi dhovanti, lohitagatampi dhovanti, na ca tena āpo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:5.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante āposamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an9.11:5.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:6.1: seyyathāpi bhante, tejo sucimpi ḍahati, asucimpi ḍahati, gūthagatampi ḍahati, muttagatampi ḍahati, khelagatampi ḍahati, pubbagatampi ḍahati, lohitagatampi ḍahati. na ca tena tejo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:6.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante tejosamena cetasā viharāmi, vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an9.11:6.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:7.1: seyyathāpi bhante, vāyo sucimpi upavāyati, asucimpi upavāyati, gūthagatampi upavāyati, muttagatampi upavāyati, khelagatampi upavāyati, pubbagatampi upavāyati, lohitagatampi upavāyati. na ca tena vāyo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.
an9.11:7.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante, vāyosamena cetasā viharāmi, vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an9.11:7.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:8.1: seyyathāpi bhante, rajoharaṇaṃ sucimpi puñchati. asucimpi puñchati, gūthagatampi puñchati, muttagatampi puñchati, khelagatampi puñchati, pubbagatampi puñchati, lohitagatampi puñchati. na ca tena rajoharaṇaṃ aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.
an9.11:8.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante rajoharaṇasamena cetasā viharāmi, vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an9.11:8.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya,
an9.11:9.1: seyyathāpi bhante caṇḍālakumārako vā caṇḍālakumārikā vā kaḷopihattho nantakavāsī gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisanto nīcacittaññeva upaṭṭhapetvā pavisati.
an9.11:9.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante caṇḍālakumārakasamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an9.11:9.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:10.1: seyyathāpi bhante usabho chinnavisāṇo sorato sudanto suvinīto rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ anvāhiṇḍanto na kiñci hiṃsati pādena vā visāṇena vā.
an9.11:10.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante usabhacchinnavisāṇasamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena.
an9.11:10.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa. so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:11.1: seyyathāpi bhante itthi vā puriso vā daharo vā yuvā vā maṇḍanaka jātiko sīsaṃ nahāto ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭīyeyya, harāyeyya jiguccheyya.
an9.11:11.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante iminā pūtikāyena aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi.
an9.11:11.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:12.1: seyyathāpi bhante puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chiddaṃ vicchiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ.
an9.11:12.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi, chiddaṃ vicchiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ.
an9.11:12.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatāsati anupaṭṭhitā assa, so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyyāti.
an9.11:13.1: atha kho so bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.11:13.2: “accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ. yohaṃ āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhiṃ.
an9.11:13.3: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato patigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā” ti.
an9.11:13.4: taggha taṃ bhikkhu accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ yo tvaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhi.
an9.11:13.5: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhikkhu accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, taṃ te mayaṃ patigaṇhāma.
an9.11:13.6: vuddhihesā bhikkhu ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
an9.11:14.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
an9.11:14.2: khama sāriputta imassa moghapurisassa purāssa ettheva sattadhā muddhā phalissatīti.
an9.11:14.3: khamāmahaṃ bhante tassa āyasmato sace maṃ so āyasmā evamāha:
